description: Prove a Meta lead pipeline end to end without running ads: action create (a test lead on the form; fields is an optional object of question key to answer, otherwise Meta fills dummy answers) | get (the form's test lead) | delete (the test lead, or leadId). Meta keeps ONE test lead per form and refuses a second until the first is deleted. A test lead goes through the same retrieval as a real one (read_meta_leads, lead webhooks, CRM syncs), spends nothing and reaches nobody; Meta deletes only test leads. formId from list_meta_lead_forms. Read back. Free.

fields.description: create: question key to answer, e.g. {"email":"test@example.com"}; omit for Meta's dummy answers

leadId.description: delete: the test lead id (default: the form's test lead)

pageId.description: the Page the form is on, when the brand has several

name: manage_meta_test_lead
title: Meta instant form test lead
